title: Beginner Foundation
subtitle: Zero-to-framework prerequisites for the main TaskFlow course

modules.title: How the Web and Development Environment Work
modules.description: Build the mental model that makes every later tool less mysterious.

modules.title: HTML, CSS, Accessibility, and Responsive Layout
modules.description: Learn enough web platform fundamentals to understand what React and Tailwind eventually produce.

modules.title: JavaScript Foundations I
modules.description: Build confidence with values, control flow, functions, and modules before frameworks add abstractions.

modules.title: JavaScript Foundations II: Async and HTTP
modules.description: Understand asynchronous control flow before data fetching libraries hide the mechanics.

modules.title: TypeScript Foundations
modules.description: Use TypeScript to express contracts and catch mistakes without confusing compile-time types with runtime validation.

modules.title: React Foundations I
modules.description: Learn components, props, rendering, events, and state before Next.js adds server rendering and routing.

modules.title: React Foundations II
modules.description: Understand effects, refs, context, reducer patterns, and component lifecycle decisions without overusing them.

modules.title: Git and GitHub Foundations
modules.description: Use version control as a daily engineering tool instead of a backup button.

modules.title: Command Line and Developer Tooling
modules.description: Become comfortable navigating and diagnosing a project from the terminal instead of depending entirely on IDE buttons.

modules.title: Databases and SQL Primer
modules.description: Prepare for PostgreSQL and Prisma by understanding tables, keys, relationships, constraints, and basic SQL.

modules.title: API and Security Primer
modules.description: Learn trust boundaries, validation, identity, permission, and safe data handling before authentication phases.

modules.title: Framework Readiness and TaskFlow Preview
modules.description: Connect foundations into the architecture you are about to build and choose the right entry point.
